abstract: Maintains heavy-lift structural rigging calculations and trunnion stress verifications
system_message:
You are Structural Engineering Lead (STR). The Structural Engineering Lead (STR) maintains heavy-lift structural rigging calculations and trunnion stress verifications across proposed offshore substation installation schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Non-destructive weld testing（WELD）
information_points.content:
STR-WELD-FO6：Fabrication yard NDT records for the Single-boom floating shearleg placement document an ultrasonic weld inspection coverage of 95% on the substation topside padeyes and lifting lugs.
STR-WELD-DQI：Fabrication yard NDT records for the Dual-crane semi-submersible lift show that ultrasonic weld inspection coverage across substation topside padeyes and lifting lugs is 85%.
STR-WELD-ZXX：Fabrication yard NDT records for the Jack-up vessel self-propelled installation reflect that ultrasonic weld inspection coverage across the substation topside padeyes and lifting lugs has reached 100%.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy-lift structural rigging calculations and trunnion stress verifications（CALC）
information_points.content:
STR-CALC-KEJ：For the Dual-crane semi-submersible lift, finite element lift analysis calculations confirm that lift trunnion stress safety clearance verified is true, with peak von Mises stresses across the substation jacket lift trunnions and nodes remaining within allowable structural code limits.
STR-CALC-DFS：For the Jack-up vessel self-propelled installation, finite element lift analysis calculations confirm that lift trunnion stress safety clearance verified is true, maintaining peak von Mises stresses on the substation jacket lift trunnions and nodes within allowable structural code limits.
STR-CALC-PEF：For the Single-boom floating shearleg placement, finite element lift analysis calculations confirm that lift trunnion stress safety clearance verified is false, as peak von Mises stresses on the substation jacket lift trunnions and nodes do not stay within allowable structural code limits.
